Teacher Copilot

A team of AI agents that tells a teacher, every morning,
who needs them, and why.

Kanushri Wadhwa · MGT 409 Final Project · https://github.com/KANUSHRI1947/teacher-copilot

The problem: 7:15 a.m., 100+ students

Every morning a teacher has to answer three questions:

  1. Who is slipping, and why?
  2. Which families only ever hear bad news?
  3. Which seniors are running out of time to graduate?

The answers are spread across the gradebook, attendance, notes and contact logs, so I went through each one separately.

45 minmy morning check, every day
2–3 ha week for my 20 family contacts
49 havg US teacher work week (RAND 2025)
−41%credit failure from weekly teacher messages home (Kraft & Rogers 2015)

What's new

Already existsWhat it misses
MagicSchool, Brisk, Khanmigo, ChatGPT for TeachersWrite content from a prompt. They don't read my records or decide who needs me.
Panorama Solara, PowerSchool EWS, Infinite CampusDistrict dashboards and risk scores. No daily teacher action list and no drafted outreach.
TalkingPoints, SchoolStatusSend and translate messages. No triage across grades, attendance and graduation. (TalkingPoints' positive-message tracking overlaps my 5:1 feature.)
Teacher Copilot: one click → a ranked "who and why" list with a strength for every student → a 5:1 positive-contact tracker → a draft in the family's language → nothing sent without the teacher. For under 15¢ per teacher per month.

How the agents work

PydanticAI · gpt-6-luna via Portkey · the boss never touches data; scoring and 5:1 math are done in Python

Cost to run

$0.00069per question (measured avg)
$0.12per teacher / month (8 questions/day)
$12100 teachers / month
$1,16610,000 teachers / month
Cost cuts: Python does the math · low reasoning effort · fewest specialists, one at a time · shared rules first for prompt caching (1,295 cached tokens at 1/10 price) · hard $ caps

Safety: attacked and defended


Planted injection in Jordan's record → hidden from every agent, shown to the teacher. Jordan's missing work still reported.
$0.0005 budget → stopped at 1,226 tokens. $1/day cap. 12-call limits.
23/23 offline safety tests pass. No send/edit tools exist.

Impact

45 → ~5 minmorning triage
~4.8 hsaved per week
~184 hper school year ≈ $7,347 of teacher time

Coverage, not just speed: it surfaced Elena (scores 76→70→58, perfect attendance) and Ricardo (strong grades, 9 absences). Neither is failing, so a failing-grade report would miss both. And Malik, the top student, had zero family contacts on record.

"The positive-message drafts would make it far easier to hit my goal of 20 family contacts a week."

Before-times: my own teaching experience. After-times: my estimate from using the app (each run measured at 8–12 s).

What's next

Doesn't work yet

  • Synthetic class of 9; one tester (me)
  • JSON file, not a live gradebook
  • Pattern-based injection check can miss paraphrases
  • Local only, not FERPA-ready

Next month

  1. Gradebook CSV import / Google Classroom
  2. "Log this contact" button that updates the 5:1 tracker
  3. Trend view: who improved after outreach
  4. LLM second-opinion injection check + red-team set
  5. Timed pilot with 3–5 teachers
